# Nimony {.unnumbered}

Nimony is the Nim 3 line: a new implementation of Nim built on a NIF pipeline, with plugins instead of
macros. This book teaches it against one fixed commit, `4ba90a781b0b` of `nim-lang/nimony`, reported by the
compiler as `0.6.3`.

Every code sample in this book is compiled and run by `tools/verify-samples.sh` at that pin. A sample that
runs on another compiler version does not count.
